identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support all stages of report development, including data input, formatting, generation, publication, and distribution, for 100% of intended report types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to support the full report generation process, from creation to distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for creating and managing staff reports, with features such as customizable templates, data visualization tools, and access control mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires staff to interact with the report generation features, necessitating a user-friendly interface.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must restrict access to staff reports based on user roles and permissions, ensuring that only authorized personnel can view and modify sensitive data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling potentially sensitive staff data, requiring appropriate access control.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The system's report generation module must be designed for easy maintenance and updates, allowing for independent modification and testing of individual components without affecting other parts of the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies ongoing maintenance and updates to the report generation functionality, requiring modular design.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate and distribute staff reports within a reasonable timeframe, such as within 1 minute for reports with up to 1000 data entries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves generating and distributing reports, which should be performed efficiently.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must redirect users to the correct login page immediately after successful registration for 100% of successful registrations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to guide users to the login page after registration, ensuring a smooth transition between these two functionalities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The system must provide clear and concise instructions on the registration and login process, allowing users to easily understand and complete these actions on their first attempt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with the registration and login process, necessitating a user-friendly experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must verify user credentials using secure authentication protocols, such as bcrypt for password hashing, to protect against unauthorized access.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling user credentials, requiring secure authentication mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must redirect users to the login page within 2 seconds after successful registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies a quick transition between registration and login, necessitating timely redirection.

functionalRequirement: System shall automatically update the available quantity of each medicine after a sale is completed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately update the available quantity of each medicine immediately after a sale is completed for 100% of sales transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to accurately update medicine quantities, ensuring correctness in inventory management.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must update the medicine quantity within 1 second after a sale is completed.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies real-time updates to inventory, necessitating timely processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must ensure data integrity for medicine quantities, even in case of temporary system failures, by implementing mechanisms such as database transactions and rollback capabilities.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes reliable updates to inventory, requiring data integrity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system's inventory management module must be designed for easy modification and updates, allowing for changes to inventory tracking rules without affecting other parts of the system.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies ongoing maintenance of the inventory management system, requiring modular design.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow site administrators to create news articles with designated publishing dates and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must allow administrators to create, edit, and delete news articles, including setting and modifying publishing and expiry dates, for 100% of intended use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system must support the creation of news articles, setting publishing and expiry dates accurately as core functionalities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide an intuitive interface for creating news articles, allowing administrators to easily set publishing and expiry dates with minimal clicks/steps.  90% of administrators should be able to create a news article with publishing and expiry dates in under 2 minutes in user testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Administrators should find the interface for creating news articles intuitive and easy to use.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must ensure that only authenticated and authorized site administrators can create, edit, and delete news articles.  Access controls must prevent unauthorized users from accessing or manipulating news article content or settings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Only authorized administrators should be able to create and manage news articles.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The news article creation module should be designed with modularity in mind, allowing for independent updates and modifications without impacting other system components. Code complexity should be kept low to facilitate easy maintenance and updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system should be designed to allow for easy updates and maintenance of the news article management functionality.

functionalRequirement: The system shall provide a calendar view of available appointment slots for each healthcare provider

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must accurately display available appointment slots for each healthcare provider, reflecting real-time availability and updates for 100% of scheduled appointments.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The calendar view must accurately represent available appointment slots for each provider.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must load and display available appointment slots within 500 milliseconds for 95% of user requests, even during peak usage times.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The calendar view should load quickly to avoid user frustration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The calendar view must present appointment slots in a clear, intuitive manner, allowing users to easily identify available times.  90% of users should be able to locate and select an available appointment slot within 1 minute in user testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The calendar view should be easy to understand and navigate.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Access to appointment information must be restricted to authorized users, with appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms in place.  Appointment data must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Appointment information should be protected from unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to search for properties based on specific criteria such as location, area, and number of bedrooms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must accurately return properties that match the user's specified search criteria (location, area, number of bedrooms) for 99% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The search functionality must accurately return properties matching the specified criteria.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must display search results within 200 milliseconds for 95% of user searches, even with a large database of properties.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Search results should be displayed quickly to avoid user frustration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search interface must be intuitive and easy to use, allowing users to easily input search criteria and refine results. 90% of users should be able to perform a search and locate a desired property within 3 minutes in user testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The search interface should be easy to use and understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The search module should be designed with modularity in mind, allowing for independent updates and modifications without impacting other system components.  Code complexity should be kept low to facilitate easy maintenance and updates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The search functionality should be designed for easy updates and maintenance.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must accurately display information and settings corresponding to the user's input for 100% of valid input values.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system must display the correct information and settings based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must respond to user input and display the relevant information and settings within 100 milliseconds for 95% of user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The system should respond quickly to user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The displayed information and settings must be presented in a clear, concise, and easy-to-understand format.  90% of users should be able to locate and interpret the displayed information within 15 seconds in user testing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The displayed information and settings should be clear and easy to understand.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Access to sensitive settings must be restricted to authorized users, with appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms in place.  Sensitive data within settings must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Sensitive settings should be protected from unauthorized access.

functionalRequirement: System shall calculate modification charges based on modifying time, date, route, availability, display new fares, and process payments through the payment gateway.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must accurately calculate modification charges considering time, date, route, availability changes, and new fares for 100% of test cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to perform accurate modification charge calculations based on various factors.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must display new fares after modification, covering all fare types and scenarios for 100% of applicable cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR explicitly mentions displaying new fares, which is a core functional aspect.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must calculate modification charges and display new fares within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under peak load conditions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions, requiring timely responses for a smooth user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all payment information using industry-standard encryption methods (e.g., AES-256) during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves payment processing, which requires robust security measures to protect sensitive data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure data integrity of all financial transactions, preventing unauthorized modification or tampering, with a success rate of 100%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves payment processing, which requires robust security measures to protect sensitive data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for modification charge calculations and payment processing for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial transactions, requiring high availability to avoid service disruptions.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate a PDF report of all transactions and send a copy to the customer's email address and another copy to the system database for monthly transaction calculation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate PDF reports containing all required transaction details (date, time, amount, etc.) for 100% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to generate and distribute transaction reports, which is a core functional aspect.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must successfully deliver transaction reports to the customer's email address and the system database for 99.9% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR mandates sending reports to specific destinations, requiring correct delivery.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate and distribute transaction reports within 5 minutes of the transaction completion for 95% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves report generation, which should be efficient to avoid delays.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must protect transaction data from unauthorized access during report generation, transmission, and storage, using appropriate access controls and encryption methods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling transaction data, which may contain sensitive information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The report generation and delivery system must be available for 99.5% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires reliable report generation and delivery for accurate record-keeping.
